purpose: One finite history-only directly block-composition-aware m2 partition experiment; preserve all previous m1 results and the frozen legacy assessment nomination.
panel: Two SHA metadata-selected ordinary-manual images per each of ten history buildings; seed2026102037; n5/9/13/17; two nested core paths; up to48 m2 endpoint blocks sampled independently of labels; all blocks new-source, core may include old-source. Fixed entrant reservoir sized to retain n17 core; insufficient capacity retained as failures. No target outcomes used.
fit_objective: For disjoint exchanged blocks, same iff their exact two-person class-count vectors coincide. Minimize weighted conditional within risk minus0.5 weighted conditional between risk plus0.03 sum squared class fractions. Risk=d/(d+training median d); d=.5(BEV_mean_pairscale+top_mean_pairscale) on unique cyclic candidates. Base pair weights equalize building/image/n/core/pair before labels; conditional within and between normalized separately. Require each arm >=5% total valid pair weight, otherwise objective infinite. Missing/mismatch distance neverzero; all-attempt structural risk evaluated separately, not optimized away.
support: Workers observed in >=4 panel images and >=3 history buildings; each class >=4 workers. Full and fold failures retained. No imputation of unknown personnel or invalid geometry.
optimizer: Two starts per K: training-only Q ordered balanced bins and seeded balanced random; seed2026102037. Deterministic coordinate descent, best improving single-person move, maximum30 accepted moves per start; retain best training objective. No additional restarts or family expansion.
folds: Existing hash-defined five two-building held-out history folds. Fit outcome scale, worker support, labels and Q starts only on remaining eight buildings.
evaluation: Exact common anchors requiring finite within and between separately for each metric; matched masks for candidate and baseline. Anchor->n->image->building aggregation, all-attempt structural failures on observed common anchors separately. Report BEV/top absolute and normalized mean/max, 9/12degree sensitivity, within and gap, valid coverage, unknown and class capacities.
baselines: Fold-refitted original Rnew2; fold Q rank labels preserving candidate class capacities; 40 fixed-seed capacity-preserving permutations. Full-history labels and controls on discovery and subsequent frozen reused assessment only.
selection: Publish both K candidates and fivefold results; no guaranteed winner. Prefer Pareto lower within and greater between gap with honest structural coverage; candidate chosen for any further assessment only after history/discovery freeze. This experiment cannot change or rescue legacy meanK3 frozen probe results.
stopping: Exactly one finite panel, two K models, two starts each across six fits. No outcome-driven extra panels or restarts. Any further work requires a separately justified proposal.
m1_limit: Original/mixed m1-derived labels remain m1 hypotheses. This new objective explicitly categorizes nonlinear m2 team endpoints, never decomposes block outcome into summed single-person distances.
